title: Slipway API model
description: api.json: one language-neutral model of a library's modules, classes, functions, methods, types, constants, and endpoints, written by a converter and read by the theme. Version 0.1; see docs/adr/0019-api-model.md.

generator.description: The tool that wrote the file, such as typedoc, rustdoc, griffe, go/doc, or a hand-written converter.

modules.description: Top-level modules, in the order the converter wants them read.

container.description: A module, class, or interface: a named thing that holds other symbols.

members.description: The symbols and containers directly inside it. What nests where is the converter's call; a class with no members is an empty array.

deprecated.description: Present when the symbol is deprecated. Every field is optional because converters know different amounts; an empty object still marks the deprecation.

description.description: Why and what to do instead, in Markdown.

replacement.description: The symbol that replaces it, as the source writes it, such as `createSite`.

since.description: The version that deprecated it, as the project numbers versions.

description.description: The doc comment in Markdown, without the comment markers and without the tags a converter moved into fields (parameters, returns, examples, deprecated).

code.description: The example as source, without code fences.

lang.description: The syntax-highlighting language, such as js, py, rs, or go.

title.description: A short label, such as "Create a site".

examples.description: Examples in the order the source lists them.

name.description: The name as the source writes it, without the module prefix, such as `createSite` or `Site.url`.

default.description: The default value as source text, not as JSON, so `{}` and `""` stay distinct.

description.description: The parameter's doc comment in Markdown.

optional.description: True when the caller may leave it out.

type.description: The type as source text, such as `string` or `CreateOptions`; a converter that cannot infer it writes `unknown`.

parameters.description: Parameters in call order. An empty array means the symbol takes none.

description.description: The return value's doc comment in Markdown.

type.description: The return type as source text, such as `Promise<Site>`; `void` when it returns nothing.

source.description: Where the symbol is written, so the page can link to it and say when it last changed.

commit.description: The commit the symbol was read from, as a lowercase hex hash of 7 to 40 characters.

file.description: The source file, relative to the project root, with forward slashes.

line.description: The 1-based line where the symbol starts.

signature.description: The declaration as source text, such as `createSite(options: CreateOptions): Promise<Site>`. Overloads live here, one per line, because the model has one symbol per name.

symbol.description: A function, method, type, constant, or endpoint: a named thing the page documents on its own.

method.description: The HTTP method, only on an endpoint.

path.description: The URL path from the server root, such as `/sites/{id}`, only on an endpoint.
